title: Breathtaking experience for our little family
text: The sunrise was breathtaking. Our daughters (12 and 14) were extremely impressed and were well supervised. They got away with it faster than their parents 😅 Beautiful setting with magnificent pictures. The early rise was more than worth it! Blessed 'Hakuna Matata 🎶' while paddling on the Mediterranean Sea 🌅❤️ An ideal ending to our trip to Barcelona. Thanks to Moana Paddle surf
author: jessicacY1529QY

title: Barcelona Sunrise on the water.
text:
Had a fantastic sunrise paddleboard with Cintia and her crew

Was absolutely beautiful, equipment was perfect, instructions were clear and easy. To top it off  she bought us a cappuccino and croissant to finish, thank you Cintia for making my last day in Barcelona the most memorable. ☕ 🥐 🌊🌅
author: Michael_M

title: fall in love with life again.
text: This will make you fall in love with life again. Loved every second of this unique experience. Absolutely worth it.
author: Pia_B

title: A Bright Experience
text: The paddle experience was amazing! Very organized from beginng to end. The intructors were very friendly and well equipped with knowledge and tools to make the experience unique for everyone. They worked well to make sure we all stayed safe, got good pictures, and took to the perfect spot to get the best views of the city and the sunrise
author: FarAway48258029889

title: Falling in love with the sunrise from the sea 🥰
text: Of the best experiences lived 🫶🏻 Watching the sunrise from the sea, with music is amazing, the views are perfect. Cintia super attentive, explains and accompanies with a beautiful energy, takes some beautiful photos, to print and decorate the house. Let's repeat more times.
author: Nanurc

title: Amazing.
text: We loved seeing the sunrise in the barceloneta! cintia is super attentive and fun, made us all enjoy it 100% we will repeat for sure!!
author: E6635SNpasqualeb

title: Great if you're anxious about the sea
text: This was such a great experience for me and my sister. I was a bit scared but was made to feel comfortable and safe. I'm looking forward to the pictures as a great memory of my time in Barcelona.
author: Tolulope_T

title: Perfect
text: Perfect experience and personalized  approach to the morning. The sunrise followed by breakfast was ideal.
author: Regina_C

title: Incredible experience an photos
text: Citia, provides a premium service, my wife and I make the trip with her. She cares about the level that each one has, she takes photos of you from the sea, and you have impressive views of the sunrise and Barcelona. She in turn had a photographer on the beach who took some amazing photos of us for an additional price. an unforgettable experience
author: ErnestSLS

title: The best sunrise
text: Cintia is the most... The best photos and videos you can have, the most beautiful sunrise I could see... Everything is perfect, magical... you have to try it...
